$comment: The vulnerability channel, as it exists from the cutover (ROLL-33; registry plan M-T6.2 commit C; contract MOD-45): security@minice.ai, read by the project owner (OPEN-OWNER-20), NOT encrypted, and offered only once delivery was proved (R6's gate, OPEN-OWNER-20's delivery proof). site/build.mjs renders the security page from this file. The PGP slot stays EMPTY ON PURPOSE: while `pgp_fingerprint` is empty the page says, in a box, that there is no key and that the mail is not encrypted, so a reporter decides how much detail to send knowing that. From R6 no registry page offers GitHub private reporting or an issue form for a vulnerability (MOD-45), which is why `advisory_url` is gone. Provisioning a key is the checklist docs/POLICY.md used to carry: generate it offline under the root ceremony's custody rules, publish the fingerprint here and in SECURITY.md in one commit, and send yourself an encrypted test before announcing it.
